# Data Integrity Checklist: SPEC-014B - Harness Adapter Manifest and Fake Registry

**Purpose**: Validate fake registry, derived runtime inventory, summary, and evidence consistency requirements before task generation
**Created**: 2026-06-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Registry Integrity

- [x] CHK001 Are the exact two required v1 fake manifest ids specified as the complete registry vocabulary? [Completeness, Spec §Harness Adapter Manifest Shape]
- [x] CHK002 Are missing required manifests, duplicate manifest ids, and unknown v1 manifest ids required to fail closed before eligibility? [Resolved, Spec §FR-061]
- [x] CHK003 Is deterministic registry ordering specified before filters are applied? [Resolved, Data Model §Fake Adapter Registry]

## Derived State Consistency

- [x] CHK004 Is runtime inventory explicitly defined as derived read state rather than durable persistence? [Completeness, Spec §Data Integrity Invariants]
- [x] CHK005 Are SQLite, localStorage, task artifact, task attempt, claim, lifecycle, governance, GitHub, tracker, successor, scheduler, and auto-merge persistence paths excluded for derived inventory? [Resolved, Plan §Data Integrity Source-Of-Truth Decisions]
- [x] CHK006 Are entry id uniqueness and deterministic response ordering specified? [Resolved, Data Model §RuntimeInventoryEntry]

## Summary And Envelope Integrity

- [x] CHK007 Are `summary.total` and per-state summary counts tied exactly to the returned post-authorization, post-filter `entries` collection? [Resolved, Contract §Success Response]
- [x] CHK008 Is a single `generated_at` timestamp and feature-flag resolution required for each evaluated response scope? [Resolved, Data Model §RuntimeInventoryEnvelope]
- [x] CHK009 Are top-level request failures required to avoid partial entry summaries? [Consistency, Contract §Error Responses]

## Eligibility Evidence Integrity

- [x] CHK010 Are same-scope task, project, assignment, governance, feature-flag, and lifecycle evidence required before an entry can be eligible? [Resolved, Spec §FR-063]
- [x] CHK011 Are absent, stale, malformed, unauthorized, cross-workspace, and cross-scope evidence cases prohibited from producing `eligible`? [Resolved, Contract §State Rules]
- [x] CHK012 Is `task_id` required for full eligibility evaluation and prohibited from claiming eligibility when absent? [Completeness, Spec §Runtime Inventory API Scope]

- [x] CHK016 Are tests required to prove stale, malformed, unauthorized, cross-workspace, or cross-scope evidence cannot produce eligible inventory? [Resolved, Spec §SC-014]
